newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Rising majority of Swedes against EU link - poll.
newsitem.headline: Rising majority of Swedes against EU link - poll.

text.p: An increasing number of Swedes are opposed to Sweden's membership of the European Union (EU), according to a survey by Sweden's Central Statistics Bureau (SCB) released on Wednesday.
The bi-annual poll on EU sympathies found 53.8 percent of 9,400 people questioned in November were opposed to EU membership while only 28.4 percent were in favour of the link.
In a similar survey six months ago, SCB found 52.4 percent of interviewees were opposed to membership and 30 percent were in favour of it. The rest were undecided.
An SCB spokeswoman said this was the first year the question of support for EU membership had been asked directly.
In previous years, following Sweden's entry to the EU in early 1995 and a referendum in November 1994, the pollsters had asked how people would vote on the issue of EU membership.
